narration: First, consecutive point clouds P_t and P_{t+1} undergo geometry-aware point sampling through eigen feature computation, thresholding, and random sampling.
Next, the sampled points are partitioned based on their azimuthal angles into four directional views: front, left, right, and rear.
Then, local geometric features are extracted using PointHop++ and matched across corresponding views.
Finally, rotation and translation are estimated to update the trajectory, and the time step advances to process the next frame.
